 FixyText is the second game announced for The Jackbox Party Pack 10 . This game involves a chat-typing rampage where players are required to type in something into a single text box for a short amount of time together. The player whose words create the biggest waves, lands the biggest laughs, gets the most votes - wins!

 First, you decide on one of four conversation types: Flirty, Serious Business, Friends & Fam, or Unknown Number. This sets which chat partners and requests are sent your way. Then, groups of players will take turns writing and voting on replies to some of the chat their phones!

 When the timer starts, everyone in your group will jump into the same text field and start writing. Get in each other's way, change each other’s words, and get the most votes from other players by making your words stand out! Oh, and one last thing: You can’t backspace OR delete. So everything you type will stay that way FOREVER!

 Extra features include:

 Collab bonuses for working on the same word

 Wacky suggestions to take your texts to the next level

 Doubling down on your votes

 No-timer mode

 Customizable characters
